entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's up? You wanna head back and[n]regroup?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm? Do you want to retreat, Joker?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's wrong? Do you want to pull out[n]of here?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Do you wish to reconvene, Joker?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh? You want to regroup?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It might be a good idea to go home[n]and regroup.
entries.uk: Може, й справді варто піти додому[n]й перегрупуватися.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Is it time for us to withdraw?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh? Would you like to regroup?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mkay, let's get goin'.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mm, we should leave for today.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All right, let's head back.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm, very well. Let us head back.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mkay, let's go back.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmm, I guess it's a good time to leave.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well then, let's go home.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Let us head back for today.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Phew, we're done for today!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's important to know when to quit.[n]Well, let's go home.
entries.uk: Важливо знати, коли зупинитися.[n]Що ж, ходімо додому.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's all for today.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Hm. That should be the conclusion of[n]today's activity.
entries.uk: Хм. На цьому сьогоднішні справи,[n]гадаю, завершено.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, we should prolly talk strategy, huh.
entries.uk: Ага, нам, певно, треба обговорити стратегію.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay. Give me a second.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay. We should have a strategy[n]meeting.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, let us review our options first.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: True, it would be a good idea to go over[n]our plan. Mona, if you please.
entries.uk: Справді, варто переглянути план.[n]Моно, якщо твоя ласка.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yup, you're right. It's on you, Mona.
entries.uk: Ага, твоя правда. Слово за тобою, Моно.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: True, we should calm ourselves.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That very well may be a good decision.[n]Go right ahead.
entries.uk: Цілком можливо, що це слушне рішення.[n]Прошу.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Mkay. I can keep goin' if that's what[n]you want.
entries.uk: Окей. Можу йти далі, якщо[n]ти так хочеш.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, I think we might be able to make[n]some more money here.
entries.uk: Ага, гадаю, тут можна ще трохи[n]заробити.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Okay, let's look around in here a little[n]bit longer then.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I agree. I expect there are still places[n]yet unseen.
entries.uk: Згоден. Гадаю, тут іще є місця,[n]яких ми не бачили.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm, yes. I think we can still keep going[n]for now.
entries.uk: Хм, так. Гадаю, поки що ми можемо[n]іти далі.
